status: development release; 97.5% exact on a development set of 237 microphone recordings that informed the recipe, below the 95% bound on shouted one-word holds
input: one hold of 16 kHz mono PCM as float32, peak-normalised to 0.5, shape [1, n]
output: log-probabilities [frames, 82]: index 0 is the CTC blank, 1..81 the dragon words in sorted order
decision: argmax over the 81 entries of the CTC log-likelihood of the entry's words plus 2.0 per word
